text:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout for release v1.9.2 -> stable. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Canary size 5%. Backout runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-v1.json :wave:
carol: ack. I'll coordinate. Quick summary: canary 5%, model rwd-3b-q4f, quantized variant. Watch latency p50/p95, error-rate, and model 'nan' token spikes.
raj: noted. I'll own primary rollback. Which metrics trip the ladder? cpu/gpu mem, error-rate > 3% over 2m, latency p95 +200ms baseline?
mira: infra note — KV-cache warming might spike memory first 5–10m. If we see GC or OOMs, immediate scale down canary or pin previous model.
sam: release note reminder: batching changes (opt-in) could increase tail latency briefly. Pin command we used: ```rwctl rollout create --model rwd-3b-q4f --version 1.9.2 --canary 5% --pin-before=stable```
carol: ok we need a clear rollback ladder in thread so on-call knows playbook. Propose ladder here, comment pls: 1) Pause traffic injection and stop further canary growth (automated). 2) Reduce canary to 0% (unwind) and monitor 2m. 3) Route traffic to previous stable model (pin previous tag). 4) If errors persist, trigger full backout and runbook step: emergency-unpin -> redeploy previous artifact -> notify customers. 5) If infra-level issues, escalate to infra-runbook (link below).
raj: +1. Add thresholds: error-rate >= 3% for 2 consecutive 2m windows OR p95 latency increase >= 200ms sustained for 3m -> step 2. I'll be primary for steps 1–3. @mira secondary for steps 4–5.
mira: got it. infra-runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/infra-escape-hatch.md. Add 'kill-switch' path: ```/ops/escape-hatch --service inference --mode drain``` — use only after step 3 fails.
sam: I can prepare a hotfix branch if rollback uncovers model-serving bug. Ping me with logs (trace id) and I'll cut a hotfix image.
oncall-bot: CANARY_METRICS update: p50 120ms (+10ms), p95 210ms (+40ms), error-rate 0.4% -> within safe margins. CPU 68%, GPU mem 72%.
carol: thanks. Everyone please ack this ladder and owners. Also confirm the pinned model hash for previous stable: sha256:3fa7b2c... (sam pls confirm)
sam: confirmed previous stable hash 3fa7b2c9f1. If we pin back, use: ```rwctl model pin --model rwd-3b-q4f --hash 3fa7b2c9f1 --route stable```
raj: ack. I'll monitor dashboards and initiate step 2 if thresholds hit.
mira: ack. I'll standby for infra escalation and have rollback nodes warmed.
carol: assigning notifications: I will post to #customers-ops if we do full backout. If anyone triggers step 3+, tag me and @sales-esc.
oncall-bot: Canary at 5% started. Watch window open 02:00-03:00 UTC. Automated rollback latch engaged. :rocket:
carol: thanks team — keeping thread pinned to the release channel. If nothing funky by 02:10 UTC we'll proceed with canary ramp plan.
